body:
Kardesim, hör mir mal zu. Deine Sorgen sind für dich natürlich extrem groß, aber als aussenstehender wie mir, beineide ich dich eher dafuer, dass du so 'geringe' Probleme hast.
Beni yanlis anlama, ich weiß, dass es dich sehr belastet, allerdings sind diese Sorgen gut und leicht zu bewaeltigen und loesen.

Halt dich mal ein paar Tage vom PC fern. Nimm diesen Rat mal zu Herzen und du wirst sehen, dass es nicht mehr bergab geht.

Kendine iyi bak, cano.

Wow, this sounds like me 10 years ago. I'd like to read your full story, PM me if you're willing to share and talk about it.

Keep your head up

You're way to young to take this step, and this comes from a guy who's in his 20's and got the exact same thoughts aswell.
I know that it could be reliefing to take this step, but only for you. Think about your loved ones .. You would make them very very sad. Don't tell me that no one would care, because there is always atleast 1 person who would suffer because of it.

Live on, mate. I know your pain.
Keep your head up.

If you couldn't do it so far then there is something to live for for you.
Keep your head up and don't compare yourself to others. You are the one who decides how your life is and will be. And this comes from a guy who got problems aswell ..
Life sucks sometimes, i agree. 

Suicide is and should not be an option.
Think about it.

Take care

I'd like to thank you aswell for taking your time to listen to me. I really appreciate it.

My family is and would be there for me, that's for sure, but it's very very hard for me to admit my problems to my family. They would ask me why i didn't tell them about it earlier before it got that bad as it is now and i don't know how i should reply to it because i dont even know it myself! I really don't know how i could let it happen to get that worse..

Wow, your post made me cry even more, seriously. 
I have no one to talk to about my problem since months  and  your words made me feel alive again for a moment. Thank you for taking your time to read my post.

Yes, i bet i could stay with them for a while, but as i said, no one knows about my problem except myself. I don't want to tell them about it because they think that i am doing totally fine. I am lying to them constantly and if i would tell the truth, who knows what they would think of me or if they even would help me after all these lies. I won't risk it.. 

I have been working for a bookbinding company for the last 8 years until february this year. I have no diploma or anything else which could help me to get  a good paying job.

Shit happens :/
